Plugin.Name: Docker Model Runner
Plugin.Description: Run AI models locally with the Docker Model Runner CLI plugin for Unraid.
Plugin.Overview:
Docker Model Runner brings the `docker model` command to the Unraid Docker CLI.
[b]Features:[/b] - Pull, run and serve AI models on your Unraid server. - The `docker model` CLI plugin is installed into the Docker CLI plugin directory and restored on every boot. - A Settings page reports the CLI version, the Model Runner state and the local models as a table with per-model update and remove actions. - Install, stop and remove the Model Runner from the page (CPU only or GPU auto); the runner image is pulled on demand. - The page sets the address the runner API is published on (all interfaces by default) and shows the ports the container is actually published on.
[b]Requirements:[/b] - Unraid 7.0 or newer - Docker 20.10 or newer
The runner image is not shipped in the plugin package; it is pulled on demand when the runner is installed from the page or with `docker model install-runner`.
